btn-close: a dialog's or a notice's close (×)
side-pane-tab: a tab of the side column (role tab, aria-selected)
summary-tab: a tab of the settings summary (role tab, aria-selected)
attachment-chip-name: an attachment's name in its chip, opening the file
sfp-plain-btn: dismissing a band (clearing a selection): the icon alone
word-table-icon-button: the word table's help, an icon in its heading
word-table-status: the word table's state in the message tools, opening it
word-table-putback: a word set aside, put back by pressing it
workbench-item: an item's tab in the work screen
workbench-item-remove: removing an item, in its tab (×)
workbench-whiteboard-color: a color's swatch in the whiteboard's picker
sfp-row-menu: a list row's menu (…), quiet in its row
